Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great alignment on scope and timeline. Attached is MAP draft v2 (spreadsheet + embedded milestone descriptions) that reflects the milestones we discussed. High level plan:

- Target close date: 2026-04-15
- Milestones:
  - Legal review (MSA/DPA/SLA) — due: 2026-03-08
  - Procurement / PO signed — due: 2026-03-22
  - Implementation kickoff (onboarding + baseline perf tests) — target: 2026-04-01
- Dependencies: Acme MSA redlines, procurement PO, access to test data/sample workload for perf validation

Could you confirm the Acme owner for legal redlines (name & email) and your expected turnaround for an initial redline pass? We want to make sure the MAP captures who owns edits on MSA/DPA/SLA and realistic review SLAs.

Attaching: 20260301-Acme-MAP-draft-v2.docx (MAP draft), sample SOW template.

Next steps (suggested):
- Acme legal uploads redlines to the thread (or share via DocuSign/Drive)
- Redwood legal (Dev Patel) to own redline tracking unless you prefer otherwise
- We’ll capture turnaround commitments in the MAP and update target close date if needed

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally with rishi and Dev to confirm owners on our side.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks for the MAP — I’ve attached an initial redline set for the MSA (acme_msa_redlines_20260302.pdf). As a first pass, our team typically expects a 3 business day turnaround for counterpart review. Rishi / Dev — forwarding Sarah’s redlines. She asked who on our side will own edits and whether we can meet a 2–3 business day turnaround. Proposed answers:

- Redwood legal (Dev Patel) will own tracking and produce the consolidated redline.
- Dev: initial pass within 2 business days of receipt; technical/SLA items routed to Product/Ops with a 3 business day review window.
- Procurement/AM (Rishi) to run PO and billing items — target PO receipt by 2026-03-22.

Please confirm or flag conflicts. Also, Dev — can you review the attached PDF and confirm if any clauses will require additional product input (especially SLA and data residency)?

Marissa

Note: this is internal — do not share our internal strategy or pricing positions externally.
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme redlines — need owners/turnaround

Thanks — I can own the MSA/DPA redline tracking and will assign an attorney to lead consolidation. Quick notes after scanning Sarah’s PDF:

- Data residency & audit rights: need input from Product on what we can commit operationally.
- SLA: several liability and uptime thresholds reference operational telemetry; I’ll pull in Ops/Product (cc to be added) for a 3 business day technical review.
- Turnaround: I can commit to an initial consolidated redline within 2 business days of receiving Acme’s editable redline (we should ask for a Word/Docx to accelerate). For complex clauses we may need another 1–2 days.
- Process: Acme sends redlines (Word preferred) -> Redwood Legal (me) consolidates -> Product/Ops reviews SLA items (3 biz days) -> Redwood returns consolidated redline + comment table.

I’ll prepare a short MAP update that lists owners, turnaround SLAs, and dependencies. If Acme is ok with Docx/Track Changes, that will speed things up.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Sarah —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redlines. Confirming Redwood’s owners and SLAs so we can lock the MAP:

- Redwood owner for MSA/DPA: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwoodinference.com).
  - Commitment: initial consolidated edit within 2 business days of receiving Acme’s editable redlines (Word/Docx preferred).
- SLA / technical items: Product/Ops to review within 3 business days after Dev routes the item. This includes availability, monitoring, and incident response language.
- Procurement / PO: Rishi Malhotra will coordinate with Acme procurement; target PO receipt by 2026-03-22.
- Target close: 2026-04-15 (pending no major legal issues).

I’ve attached MAP v3 that explicitly lists these milestones, owners, due dates, and dependencies. Please confirm if Acme can provide a Word copy of the redlines — that will let us meet the 2 business day SLA. If you need a faster turnaround on any specific clause, flag it in the body of your reply and we’ll expedite.

Next steps:
- Sarah: share editable redlines (Word) or confirm turnaround if you prefer PDF.
- Dev: once editable redlines received, consolidate and route SLA items to Product/Ops.
- Rishi: start procurement cadence and confirm PO timing.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
